strategyDescription: One model call per PR extracts closed-vocabulary facets (area, kind) from the title, a URL-stripped 500-char body excerpt and labels. TypeScript then partitions deterministically by area, sends singleton and 'other' areas to unclassified, asks one agent per surviving area for a label and summary, and validates coverage, uniqueness and ranking.
noveltyRationale: The nearest prior also used model judgments, but it discovered open-ended themes and assigned PRs greedily (simulated, never executed). This design fixes a closed vocabulary up front, makes the model produce per-PR structured facets only, and derives cluster membership by deterministic grouping in TypeScript. The other priors used labels, keyword rules, hand-written membership or TF-IDF with no model calls.
